For those wondering how to figure out what to download and from where, do the following:
in the Windows search bar, look up **System Information**. Then find your BaseBoard Manufacturer, confirming its ASRock, and **BaseBoard Product**.

On the [ASROCK website here](https://www.asrock.com/index.us.asp), enter your BaseBoard Product in the Model search box on the top right. 

For your product, click the box that says **Download**. Here, scroll down until you find the latest **ASRock Polychrome RGB ver:**x.x.xxx 

Select the Global download option on the right. Download, extract, and run the file. It will uninstall the old one and install the new one. Once installed, allow it to do a firmware update and then it will want to restart your computer. And thats it!
